title: Competitor Mapping
subtitle: You're losing deals to competitors and don't fully understand why. Or you're preparing a
useWhen: market-entry strategy and need to know the landscape before you move.
howToUse: Competitor mapping is the structured process of plotting your competitors across dimensions that matter to your customers price, capability, speed, service model, target segment, and key differentiators. Done well, it reveals clusters of competition (where everyone is fighting), white spaces (where no one plays), and your own positioning clarity. AI can build a preliminary map quickly when given enough context about your market.
steps: List your top 5–8 direct and indirect competitors before prompting.
Choose 4–6 dimensions that your customers actually use to evaluate options.
Look for white spaces combinations of dimensions that no competitor occupies.

Update your map every six months or after any significant competitor move. See exactly where you stand and where the gaps are Most competitor maps list only direct competitors by product category. The most dangerous competitors are often indirect, the workaround your customer uses instead of buying anything. Spreadsheets, manual processes, and doing nothing are your biggest competitors in most B2B markets. Map the workaround first, then the direct alternatives.
origin: Strategic management methodology — competitor analysis frameworks, 1980s onwards
promptBody:
Act as a competitive intelligence analyst.
My business        :  [WHAT YOU DO AND WHO YOU SERVE]
Key competitors :  [LIST 5–8 DIRECT AND INDIRECT]
Map each competitor across these dimensions:
Price positioning (budget / mid / premium)
Target customer (SMB / mid-market / enterprise)
Core strength (what they are known for)
Core weakness (where they are consistently criticised)
Key differentiator (what makes them choose-able)
After mapping :
1. Where is the market most crowded?
2. What white space exists that no competitor occupies?
3. Where am I most vulnerable to competitive pressure?
4. What is the one thing I must own to be clearly different?

proTip:
The most valuable output is not the map itself,  it is the white space analysis. Ask AI
specifically: 'Given this competitive map, describe the customer who is currently
underserved by every player in this market.' That customer is your Blue Ocean
opportunity.
